verdict.rationale: Asking whether a 3D library and its editor ship a built-in AI assistant is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence shows no such assistant in three.js, its editor, or its docs. The llms.txt files are machine-readable docs for external coding agents to consume, which is an adjacent feature rather than an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
